title: Bilingual EN+Marathi outline
promptText:
Create a bilingual outline (English + Marathi) for the public communication below.

Context: MahaTransco / district administration citizen advisory or project update.

Output structure:
A. English outline
   - Title
   - 5–7 section headings
   - Under each heading: 2–3 bullet points (not full paragraphs)
B. Marathi outline
   - Same structure, natural official Marathi (not word-for-word calque)
C. Glossary
   - 8–12 key terms in EN | MR for consistent reuse across drafts

Rules:
- Keep tone formal and neutral.
- Do not invent dates, feeder names, compensation amounts, or contact numbers.
- Use [VERIFY] for any missing fact.
- Headings should be usable as-is for a notice, press note, or website page.

SOURCE BRIEF:
[Paste English or Marathi draft / bullet points]
